description: Sprint 5 - Immersive Reading Mode with swipe navigation, pinch-to-zoom, cost estimation, and first-use onboarding. All four features are implemented as a single coherent unit.
steps: STEP 1 - Create branch: git checkout -b feature/alpha-sprint5 from current HEAD (feature/alpha-sprint4)

STEP 2 - Create features/viewer/useSwipeNavigation.ts: A custom hook that handles touch-based swipe gestures for page navigation. Use touchstart/touchmove/touchend events. Threshold: 50px horizontal movement, less than 30px vertical deviation. Swipe left = next page, swipe right = previous page. Only active in single-page mode and NOT editing mode. Must distinguish from pinch (only when 1 finger active). Include a page transition CSS animation (slide-in from side). Hook accepts: containerRef, onNext, onPrev, enabled (boolean based on single mode + not editing). Return nothing but attach/detach listeners via useEffect.

STEP 3 - Create features/viewer/usePinchZoom.ts: A custom hook for pinch-to-zoom on mobile. Detect two-finger touch, calculate distance between points, update zoom accordingly. Bounds: 0.5 to 4x (same as button controls in MangaViewer). Transform-origin at pinch center. Double-tap detection (two taps within 300ms at same approximate position) to reset zoom to 1x. Must coexist with swipe (swipe = 1 finger, pinch = 2 fingers). Hook accepts: containerRef, zoom/setZoom state, enabled. Uses touch events directly.

STEP 4 - Integrate swipe navigation into MangaViewer.tsx: Import and call useSwipeNavigation in MangaViewer, passing containerRef, onNext, onPrev, and enabled = !stripMode && !isEditingMode && !isPaintMode && !isAddingBubble && !editingBubbleId. Add a page indicator overlay (page X/Y) that shows briefly (2 seconds fade) when navigation occurs - uses CSS animation. The page indicator needs total pages + current index, so add totalPages and currentPageIndex to MangaViewerProps (App.tsx will pass them).

STEP 5 - Integrate pinch-to-zoom into MangaViewer.tsx: Import and call usePinchZoom, passing containerRef, zoom/setZoom, and enabled = !stripMode. This replaces/augments the existing zoom buttons (they still work but now touch zoom also works).

STEP 6 - Clean mode tap zones: In MangaViewer.tsx, when isCleanMode is true, add an overlay div with three tap zones: left 20% taps prev, right 20% taps next, center 60% toggles UI back (calls onToggleCleanMode). Use onClick handlers on absolutely positioned divs. Show a brief reading indicator (page X/Y) when navigating in clean mode that fades after 1.5s.

STEP 7 - Create features/translator/costEstimation.ts: A utility module with ENGINE_PRICING constant map and estimateCost function. ENGINE_PRICING keyed by EngineId with input/output prices per 1M tokens: GEMINI_FLASH/GEMINI_35_FLASH $0.15/$0.60, GEMINI_PRO $1.25/$10, GPT4O $2.50/$10, GPT4O_MINI $0.15/$0.60. Other engines (ICHIGO, TORII, DEEPL, GOOGLE) = 0/0 (free or not token-based). estimateCost(ocrEngine: EngineId, transEngine: EngineId, pageCount: number): number. Average tokens per page: OCR = 1500 input + 500 output, Translation = 500 input + 500 output. Formula: for each page, (ocr_input_tokens * ocr_input_price + ocr_output_tokens * ocr_output_price + trans_input_tokens * trans_input_price + trans_output_tokens * trans_output_price) / 1_000_000.

STEP 8 - Add cost estimation display in App.tsx sidebar: When autoTranslate is OFF and there are idle images in history, show a small cost estimate label near the 'Traduzir Todas' button and near each individual 'Traduzir' play button. Use estimateCost with current ocrEngine, transEngine, and page count. Format as '~$X.XXX estimado'. Also show it in the OCR review banner in MangaViewer.tsx (next to 'Confirmar e Traduzir' button) for single-page cost.

STEP 9 - Create components/OnboardingModal.tsx: A modal overlay shown on first visit. Checks localStorage for 'mangalens-onboarding-done'. If not set, shows a modal with 4 steps (carousel style): Step 1 'Arraste ou selecione suas paginas de manga' (ArrowUpTrayIcon), Step 2 'Escolha o engine de OCR e traducao' (Cog6ToothIcon), Step 3 'Veja a traducao aplicada nos baloes' (SparklesIcon), Step 4 'Edite baloes, salve na biblioteca, exporte' (PencilSquareIcon from @heroicons/react/24/outline). Navigate with 'Proximo'/'Anterior' buttons and dot indicators. 'Comecar' button on last step dismisses and sets localStorage flag. Styling matches existing modals (dark slate-900 bg, rounded-xl, backdrop blur).

STEP 10 - Add OnboardingModal to App.tsx and a re-open trigger: Import and render OnboardingModal at the bottom of App.tsx (next to other modals). Add a small '?' button in the sidebar footer grid (settings buttons area) that re-opens the onboarding by clearing the localStorage flag and setting a state. The onboarding modal manages its own visibility via localStorage + an optional forceOpen prop.

STEP 11 - Add CSS for page transition animation in index.css: Add @keyframes slide-in-left, slide-in-right, and fade-out for the page indicator. Add .animate-slide-left, .animate-slide-right, .animate-fade-indicator utility classes.

STEP 12 - Update App.tsx to pass totalPages and currentPageIndex to MangaViewer: In the single-page MangaViewer render, compute and pass totalPages={history.length} and currentPageIndex={getCurrentIndex()}.
STEP 13 - Run npm run typecheck && npm run build to verify everything compiles cleanly. Fix any type errors.
STEP 14 - Commit all changes with message 'feat: sprint 5 - immersive reading, pinch-zoom, cost estimation, onboarding' and push to origin feature/alpha-sprint5. Create PR against main.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with no errors
npm run build produces a successful production bundle
useSwipeNavigation hook exists and is integrated into MangaViewer
usePinchZoom hook exists and is integrated into MangaViewer
Clean mode has tap zones for navigation
Cost estimate labels appear near translate buttons when autoTranslate is off
OnboardingModal shows on first visit and can be re-triggered
Page indicator shows briefly on swipe navigation
Branch feature/alpha-sprint5 is pushed and PR is opened against main
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run build
findings: All 4 features implemented and verified. Typecheck and build pass cleanly. Swipe navigation uses 50px threshold. Pinch zoom bounds 0.5-4x. Cost estimation uses ENGINE_PRICING map. Onboarding uses localStorage key mangalens-onboarding-done. Added ? button to settings grid (now 8 cols). Clean mode tap zones: 20/60/20 split.
